idea-plugin.name: Powder
idea-plugin.description:
A calm dark theme for the Islands UI, inspired by Xcode: neutral graphite backgrounds, powder pink keywords and soft pastel accents.

  • The whole Islands Dark UI repainted in graphite, with a soft blue accent.
  • Quiet syntax colours: keywords, strings, numbers, function declarations, types and annotations are coloured; calls get a lighter powder blue, operators are dimmed, fields and variables stay plain text, so the code does not turn into confetti.
  • Terminal and console colours from the same palette.
  • Bitstream Vera Sans Mono 13.5 with line height 1.1 in the editor and the terminal; the font is bundled. Applied once when the theme is first switched on - change it any time afterwards.

Pairs well with Frost for translucent, blurred IDE windows.
